provenance_finding.issue: The RUNNING UI is deployed from a commit NEWER than the register of record.
provenance_finding.detail: At b142cf88 the Execution Quality table has 13 columns with NO Exchange ms / Terminal state / Operator action / Reject category / Leader->send ms; and the Reconciliation panel is "Ledger vs Exchange" with NO "Actionable Critical Items" table. The LIVE DOM has an 18-column Execution Quality table incl. EXCHANGE MS, and a recon Actionable Critical Items table incl. REJECT CATEGORY/COIN/WALLET. Rows UI-FP-119/137/139/140 therefore certify the LIVE surface, which is ahead of the register commit.
provenance_finding.recommendation: Certify these 4 rows against the deployed commit (5223ce2/ecd6788), or fold the live source into the register; the register currently pins b142cf88 which lacks the fields.
